assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is a service that addresses the documented clinical indication requiring precertification for coverage under SilverBridge Advantage policy.
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility.
This decision does not preclude the possibility of future coverage if proper authorization is secured.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
